summary: This is a Cypress test that visits a website, finds and clicks a 'Tags' link, and then clicks on a link containing the text 'jomla'. It's checking that the site's tag functionality works by navigating through these elements.

explanations.1: This starts a test suite — a collection of related tests — with the label 'Joomla Test'.
explanations.2: This defines an individual test case within the suite; the string describes what the test is checking for.
explanations.3: This tells Cypress to open that website in a browser as the starting point for the test.
explanations.6: This finds a link (anchor tag) containing the text 'Tags' and simulates a user clicking it.
explanations.10: This finds a link containing 'jomla' and clicks it; note there's a typo here — it probably should be 'joomla'.
